# coolify_application_stop

Stop a Coolify application. Creating this resource sends a stop signal to the specified application. Deleting this resource is a no-op — it does not start the application.

## Exemplo de Uso

```terraform
resource "coolify_application_stop" "stop_my_app" {
  application_uuid = coolify_application_dockerimage.api.id
  docker_cleanup   = false
}
```

## Argumentos e Atributos

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_uuid` (String) UUID of the application to stop.

### Optional

- `docker_cleanup` (Boolean) Remove associated Docker containers and images when stopping.

## Importação

```shell
terraform import coolify_application_stop.example <application-uuid>
```
